title: Indian shares likely to fall as Iran war drags on
title_zh: 随着伊朗战争的持续，印度股市可能下跌
summary: March 27 (Reuters) - Indian shares are on course to open lower on Friday, tracking global stocks and elevated Brent crude prices, as hopes for a resolution to the Iran war have ebbed. U.S.
summary_zh: 路透 3 月 27 日 - 由于解决伊朗战争的希望已经减弱，印度股市周五开盘走低，追随全球股市和布伦特原油价格的上涨。我们。

title: Claude AI Maker Anthropic Considers IPO as Soon as October

summary: (Bloomberg) -- Anthropic PBC is considering going public as soon as in October, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence company races with rival OpenAI Inc.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Anthropic PBC 正在考虑最早在 10 月份上市，因为这家人工智能公司正与竞争对手 OpenAI Inc. 展开竞争。

title: Meta, social media stocks sink on fallout from lawsuit losses
title_zh: Meta、社交媒体股票因诉讼损失而下跌
summary: Meta stock fell more than 8% and dragged  other social stocks down amid fallout from its loss in a landmark social media addiction lawsuit.
summary_zh: 由于在一场具有里程碑意义的社交媒体成瘾诉讼中败诉，Meta 股票下跌超过 8%，并拖累其他社交股票下跌。

title: Job cuts at Meta, Epic Games, but new unemployment claims hold steady
title_zh: Meta、Epic Games 裁员，但新申请失业救济人数保持稳定
summary: Meta laid off roughly 700 workers across multiple divisions, while the Fortnite publisher Epic Games announced it was slashing over 1,000 roles.
summary_zh: Meta 在多个部门解雇了约 700 名员工，而《堡垒之夜》发行商 Epic Games 则宣布裁员 1,000 多人。
